[Thinking]
**Clarifying Bathurst winners**

The user asked in Dutch who won the Top 10 Shootout in Bathurst. It likely relates to the Bathurst 1000 in motorsport, but they didn't specify which year. I should ask for clarification. The 2023 winner was Brodie Kostecki, but I want to double-check. I should mention that it's an annual event and ask if they mean the most recent winner. If they want, I can also provide a list of recent winners. Keeping it concise is key!
[/Thinking]

Over welk jaar heb je het? De Top 10 Shootout voor de Bathurst 1000 wordt elk jaar gereden — wil je de winnaar van dit jaar, een specifiek jaar, of de meest recente uitslag?
